question: Which Amendment enabled 27% reservation for OBC in government and private educational institutes in 2006?
solution:
The correct answer is **__93__rd**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On the recommendation of the **Mandal Commission**, a **27% reservation for OBC** has been provided in **1992**.
 
• It has provided reservations in **government jobs and higher educational institutes**.
 
• By the** 93rd amendment**, it has added two new clauses under **articles 15 and 16** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The new clauses **15(4) and 16(4)** empower the State to make special provisions for any socially and educationally backward class of citizens.
 
• SC held the constitutionality of amendment in 1992 in the **Indra Sawhney vs Union of India case**.
 
• With SC's judgement, it was clear that the **creamy layer **among **OBCs** should be** excluded from the reservation**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
 

 **Amendment**
 **Significance**
 
 

 77th Amendment 
 It extended reservations for promotion in employment for Scheduled Castes and Tribes (SCs and STs).
 
 

 86th Amendment 
 Article 21A was added which state that the State shall provide free and compulsory education to all children the aged of six to fourteen years 
 
 

 92nd Amendment 
 Four languages Bodo, Dogri, Maithili and Santhali were added to the 8th schedule of the constitution.
